title: A CI status line never calls a draft run or a run with skipped required jobs green
why: A reader trusts the green line and merges an untested head; the merge tool's own checks should still refuse. SAMPLE 17:33 CST Nov 14 (runner 11, 17:31 CST, its own mistake; relayed; triage read none; n=1 for this form): it read degen #711's `ci-done` check row as green at 17:26 CST while its `all-jobs-passed` row was red. `ci-done` is a successful job even when the rollup fails (its comment says "checks (failure), all-jobs-passed (failure)"). It told the coordinator CI was green. Runner 11's words: the hook line "CI green on <sha>: no failing jobs" (hooks/ci_wake.py:318, found by triage) also fired while jobs were still queued. Guard proposed by runner 11, and the home is this step (one record per question; a status line that reads green when the rollup is not): a hook or tool line that prints the `all-jobs-passed` conclusion by name for a PR head, so no session infers green from `ci-done` or from the "CI green" line; a head with all-jobs-passed red or queued prints no green line. First act of its lane: read what ci_wake.py counts around line 318 and whether it counts queued jobs (unread by triage). Runner 11 now reads `all-jobs-passed` by name (its own practice change; no guard stops the mistake today). Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard.
source: coordinator 12:16 CST Nov 12, from batch runner 10 at 12:15 CST on #2814
note: A PostToolUse hook on update_pull_request printed "CI green on d783a41: no failing jobs" when the only run on that head was the draft run (27 jobs skipped, 1 success); the ready run had not started. Fix: a run whose required jobs were skipped, or a draft run, never reads green; say "no ready run yet". Red first. Lane started 12:16 CST, before this step was filed (coordinator pick, page item 585). PR class (triage 11, REST 22:01 CST Nov 17): closed-unmerged #2843; the step is still doing with no live PR.
